Case study  /  Competitive calligraphy platform

Babel Dabble

A real-time, global competitive calligraphy platform that turns Chinese literacy into a game. Players practice writing characters, then challenge each other in timed matches. I worked across the whole stack as a junior developer on contract.

Product PRACTICE · COMPETE · RETAIN
01 — The problem

Characters are easy to forget

Learners of Chinese run into "character amnesia": they can't recognize characters, confuse similar ones, and can't write them from memory, often with no immersive environment to practice in. Babel Dabble turns practice into a game, so building literacy feels more like a hobby than homework.

02 — The app

Timed matches against other players

In a match, a player gets a prompt ("Please write: zhǎo — to try to find") and writes the character against the clock. They can invite connected users to matches, drill in practice mode with their own word lists, and track progress on a leaderboard and stats page. An event calendar schedules competitions.

Practice mode builds the word associations that help characters stick; competition keeps players coming back.
